items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I saw Paul Whiteman's band... and Bing Crosby, and Jack and Charlie Teagarden were in the band playing that old Archer Pier.

ctx.x: Do you have any idea what year that was, Cliff?

About '28 and '29 and the thirties, through school. From '28 I heard the original Claude Hopkins band, they used to play at the old Archer Pier, it was a very famous spot to play all the big name bands.

And of course, they all played the colleges - they'd be split up, you know, and I would be playing the colleges, too, the local bands, so I had a chance to hear these people in person. Nowadays, a boy goes to school, he goes to college, and he gets the charts, he gets Woody Herman's charts. But I had a chance to be there in person and watch these people. That was my musical training.
